Merge the persisted catalog with current live primary/review/fork/new-chat tabs by UI ID before building otherChats. Live titles should take precedence and current-chat exclusion must remain.

Keep existing lastUserMessageAt filtering and source transcript formatter/attachment path in the five warm-transcript cases.
Add a real Rust DB/DTO regression before claiming production hidden-session hydration. A mocked IPC field alone is not database proof.
